With more and more voices looking forward 
to it, excitement for the URA Finals was 
steadily building.

<chrname>'s popularity is still so-so, so we must 
work even harder, but—

<chrname> has also been steadily gaining fans and 
getting closer to becoming a "Star 
Umamusume"—

<chrname> has also been captivating people's hearts 
with her overwhelming charm—

Joined by Trainer Kiryuin and Happy Meek, 
who had grown significantly, everyone 
renewed their determination for the 
upcoming race.
